_comment: VS Code native MCP configuration (VS Code 1.99+). Save as .vscode/mcp.json in your workspace, or open the user-level mcp.json via the 'MCP: Open User Configuration' command. NOTE: VS Code uses the 'servers' key (NOT 'mcpServers' or 'mcp.servers'). After saving, click the play icon next to the server entry to start it, or run 'MCP: List Servers' to verify. Replace the vault path before use.
